# Hotel Lazeez, Barwala (Hisar, Haryana)

> Fully air-conditioned budget hotel on Hansi Road, Barwala, district Hisar, Haryana 125121, India. Rated 4.8/5 by 150+ guests. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 91291 91900.

## Rooms (all AC, price per night)
- Standard AC Room: ₹800 (compact)
- Deluxe AC Room: ₹1,000 (medium, almirah included)
- Super Deluxe AC Room: ₹1,200 (largest, almirah included)

## Facilities
In-house restaurant, DJ party hall, free Wi-Fi, LED TV, attached bathrooms, CCTV, parking, 24x7 front desk.
